name: a stack of covers fans into a full library
looks: Two product covers sit stacked close together under a headline. They separate and more covers fan in beside them, each a different colour, until a row of six sits fanned out evenly, each slightly offset and rotated, reading as one full catalogue.
build: Covers are DOM cards with kit.rng-seeded offset x/y/rotation, staggered entrance 10-30% uneven on a spring (kit.springEase), expanding from a tight stack to an even fanned row.
sound: A soft cluster of hits as the covers fan out, one per cover landing.
prompt: Start on two product covers stacked close together, then let them separate and more covers fan in beside them, each a different colour, offset and slightly rotated, until a full row sits fanned out reading as one catalogue under a single headline.
